the.*: the — той самий, про який мова
the.the face: the — це «обличчя», про яке далі (of Africa)
the.the invitation: the — запрошення, про яке далі (to every argument)

gloss.don’t: не (з do: don’t have to = не мусиш)
gloss.do: do — замість «приймаєте» (of course you do = звісно, приймаєте)

clips.line: Uh, we don’t accept American currency, sir.
clips.note: Ron is in London. He wants to pay with American dollars, but the shop doesn't take them.
A man talks about hungry children in Africa. It's not okay for him: he can't accept it.
around: I can’t accept that the face of Africa is a hungry child.

clips.line: You don’t have to accept the invitation to every argument
clips.note: Don tells some advice from a friend: when people want to argue, you don't have to say yes.
around: or criticism of you, and I was like, holy… you’re right.
